rows.line: まあヴァンパイアってそういうものだと思うんですけれども
rows.en1: I mean, that's kind of what vampires do.
rows.en2: That's just how it goes with vampires.

rows.en2: One part I really dug was

rows.en1: I felt the same way about the action.
rows.en2: Same deal with the action scenes.

rows.line: やっぱりストーリーに結局還元されるような気はしますね。
rows.en1: It all comes back to the story.
rows.en2: In the end, it's a story problem.

rows.line: それを結局使い所が特にストーリーに用意されていない
rows.en1: They never really give it a chance to shine.
rows.en2: There's nowhere to actually use it.

rows.line: そうですね、あの結構そういう意味では
rows.en1: In that sense,
rows.en2: So yeah, in that way,

rows.line: 最後は後悔してしまうことばかりやってしまう
rows.en1: He keeps doing stuff he regrets.
rows.en2: He just keeps screwing up.

rows.line: 制御不能の能力を背負ってしまったことで
rows.en1: He's stuck with this power he can't control.
rows.en2: He's got to live with it.

rows.line: そこにフォーカス置かれるわけでもないっていう
rows.en1: It's not like they really dig into that.
rows.en2: They don't really focus on it.

rows.line: どこにも触れてないなっていう感じになりますね。
rows.en1: It kind of doesn't go anywhere.
rows.en2: It never really lands anywhere.

rows.ja: 〜があればよかったかもしれない
rows.line: ボディホラーみたいなのがあれば良かったかもしれないですね。
rows.en1: Some body horror would've been nice.
rows.en2: It could've used some body horror.

rows.line: すっごく好きな映画だったんで、もう何回も見てる
rows.en1: I've seen it a million times.
rows.en2: I've watched that one over and over.

rows.line: バンパイアにまだなりきってないところ
rows.en1: He's not fully there yet.
rows.en2: He's only halfway there.

rows.line: 逆に言うとちょっと真面目すぎるかもしれないけど
rows.en1: Then again, maybe a little too serious.
rows.en2: Flip side, it's kind of too serious.

rows.ja: もう少し〜ても良かった
rows.line: もう少しとんがっても良かったかもしれないけど
rows.en1: They could've pushed it a little more.
rows.en2: It could've been a bit edgier.

rows.line: 私の中ではこれまでのベストかもしれないですよ。
rows.en1: For me, it might be his best yet.
rows.en2: Personally, I'd say it's his best.

rows.ja: 言い出したらキリがない
rows.line: いろいろこう言い出したらキリがない
rows.en1: I could go on forever.
rows.en2: Don't get me started.

rows.en1: whether it works for you or not
rows.en2: whether you buy it or not

rows.ja: なかなか難しいところ
rows.line: なかなか難しいところでありますね。

rows.en2: Yeah, that's tricky.

rows.en1: That's it? That's all you've got?
rows.en2: Wait, that's all?

rows.line: オリジンとしては定番の流れというか
rows.en1: It's the usual formula.
rows.en2: Pretty standard stuff.

rows.ja: 小骨が引っかかったような
rows.line: すごく小骨が引っかかったような感じ
rows.en1: It's like something stuck in your throat.
rows.en2: It kind of nagged at me.

rows.line: そういうタイプの映画なのかなって思わざるを得ない

rows.en2: You kind of have to assume that.

rows.line: まぁちょっとアレですよね。
rows.en1: It's kind of, you know...
rows.en2: It's a little iffy.

rows.line: ただのクズじゃんと思ってしまうんですね。
rows.en1: You can't help thinking he's a scumbag.
rows.en2: He just comes off as a jerk.

rows.line: それはそれでいいじゃないですか。
rows.en1: And that's fine.
rows.en2: Which is fine, honestly.

rows.line: そういうキャラクターというのは別に全然アリなんで
rows.en1: That's totally fine by me.
rows.en2: I'm all for that.

rows.ja: 自分のやりたいようにやる
rows.line: 自分のやりたいようにやるキャラクター
rows.en1: A guy who just does his own thing.
rows.en2: He does whatever he wants.

rows.line: その辺はモヤモヤしましてね。
rows.en1: I couldn't quite get past that.
rows.en2: That part left me kind of unsatisfied.

rows.ja: どう受け取っていいかわからない
rows.line: どう受け取っていいかわからないってところもありました
rows.en1: I didn't know what to make of it.
rows.en2: Not sure how I'm supposed to take that.

rows.ja: わざわざ〜する必要はない
rows.line: 全く同じものとわざわざ戦う必要はないわけで
rows.en1: There's no need to go out of your way.
rows.en2: Why even bother?

rows.line: 用意することができてないっていうだけの話なのかな
rows.en1: It's really just that simple.
rows.en2: That's all it comes down to.

rows.ja: 〜って結構思っちゃいますよね
rows.line: 描きたいことってないのかなって結構思っちゃいますよね。
rows.en1: Makes you wonder, you know?
rows.en2: You kind of start to wonder.

rows.en1: But if you go there,
rows.en2: Well, by that logic,

rows.en1: Eh, fair enough.
